description: Mechanically checkable subset of voices/amy.md. Judgment rules stay in the markdown; only put a rule here if a regex can decide it.
banned_phrases: at the end of the day
take it to the next level

banned_regex.label: Motivational-poster cadence
banned_regex.rx: (?i)\b(embrace the journey|trust the process|reach for the stars|the sky'?s the limit|be all that you can be|you are enough as you are)\b
banned_regex.example: Embrace the journey and trust the process.

banned_regex.label: AI contrast scaffolding
banned_regex.example: This isn't just about forgiveness, it's about growth.

banned_regex.label: Corporate hype register
banned_regex.example: The workshop was a total game changer for our team.

banned_regex.label: Therapist-speak diagnosing the reader
banned_regex.example: You may be feeling overwhelmed right now.

signature_moves.label: Rhetorical questions as pivots
signature_moves.note: Measured at 4.1 per 1k words in the samples. The floor is a quarter of that and the cap double: a conversion with none reads as a lecture, and one per sentence reads as a tic.

signature_moves.label: Sentence starting with But
signature_moves.note: Measured at 2.3 per 1k in the samples. Cap only, no floor: But-starts are a tendency, and an editor installing them on purpose installs a tic.

contrastive_pairs.would: Mercy is radical kindness, and it will not be convenient.
contrastive_pairs.would_never: In conclusion, mercy is a powerful tool for personal growth.

contrastive_pairs.would: I have a big mouth and a soft heart, and I use both at the wrong times.
contrastive_pairs.would_never: I leverage my platform to empower others on their journey.

contrastive_pairs.would: I am overwhelmed most days, and I pretend it is about the news.
contrastive_pairs.would_never: You may be feeling overwhelmed by the demands of modern life.

contrastive_pairs.would: Rest is subversive. Nobody claps for it, and it saves you anyway.
contrastive_pairs.would_never: It's important to prioritize self-care in today's fast-paced world.
